posts.headline: Warning
posts.body:
Many mouthwashes with alcohol kill good bacteria too.
Look for alcohol-free formulas that preserve your oral microbiome.

bridge_product.name: DentaSmile
bridge_product.description: Natural oral health formula targeting the root cause of tooth decay and gum inflammation with plant-based ingredients.
bridge_product.audience: Adults experiencing tooth pain, sensitivity, and early signs of gum disease.
